views.name: player_ratings
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.id AS player_id,
  p.player_fifa_api_id AS overall_rating
FROM Player AS p
views.description: Selects player ratings from the player table.

views.name: player_heights
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.height,
  p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
views.description: Selects player height and player name.

views.name: player_crossing_performance
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  T1.player_id
FROM player_ratings AS T1
JOIN player_attributes AS T2
  ON T1.player_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE
  T2.crossing > 0
views.description: Selects players based on their crossing action performance.

views.name: league_goals_2015_2016
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM Match AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League'
AND strftime('%Y', m.date) = '2015'
GROUP BY l.name
views.description: Calculate total goals scored by each league in the 2015/2016 season.

views.name: match_league_goals
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS home_team_goals,
    SUM(m.away_team_goal) AS away_team_goals
FROM Match AS m
JOIN League AS l
    ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
views.description: Aggregate goals scored by each league in each match.

views.name: game_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.id AS game_id,
  m.season AS season,
  t1.team_short_name AS home_team,
  t2.team_short_name AS away_team,
  m.home_team_goal AS home_team_goal,
  m.away_team_goal AS away_team_goal
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN Team AS t1
  ON m.home_team_api_id = t1.team_api_id
JOIN Team AS t2
  ON m.away_team_api_id = t2.team_api_id
WHERE
  m.season = '2015/2016'
views.description: Selects all game events for the specified season.

views.name: goal_difference
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  e.game_id AS game_id,
  e.home_team_goal - e.away_team_goal AS goal_difference
FROM game_events AS e
views.description: Calculates the goal difference for each game.

views.name: team_buildUpPlaySpeed
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.buildUpPlaySpeed AS buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes AS t
JOIN Team AS t2
  ON t2.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
views.description: Selects the buildUpPlaySpeed for each team.

views.name: top_4_teams_buildUpPlaySpeed
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  T2.buildUpPlaySpeed AS buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2
  ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
ORDER BY T2.buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4
views.description: Selects the buildUpPlaySpeed of the top 4 teams based on their ranked buildUpPlaySpeed.

views.name: league_match_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT league_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match
GROUP BY league_id
views.description: Calculate the number of matches played for each league.

views.name: average_height
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(AVG(P.height) AS REAL) AS average_height
FROM Player AS P
views.description: Calculates the average height of the filtered players.

views.name: team_stats_2012
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  T1.team_long_name AS team_long_name,
  T2.buildUpPlayPassing AS buildUpPlayPassing,
  SUM(T2.buildUpPlayPassing) AS total_buildUpPlayPassing
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2
  ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.date) = '2012'
GROUP BY T1.team_long_name
views.description: Calculate team statistics for the year 2012.

views.name: league_goals_per_season
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.name
views.description: Calculate the total goals scored by each league across all seasons.

views.name: top_leagues_by_goals
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM Match AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY total_goals DESC
LIMIT 5
views.description: Rank leagues by total goals scored, returning the top 5.
